---
title: "Brazil"
---

```{r setup}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
pacman::p_load(DBI, RSQLite, jsonlite, dplyr, ggplot2, scales, plotly, knitr)
source("../../R/db.R"); source("../../R/plots.R")
LOGO <- "../../XKDRORGFILES/XKDR_Logomark_RGB_Full_Colour.png"
ISO3 <- "BRA"
con  <- err_con()
B    <- latest_build(con); bc <- bocpd_settings(con, B$build_id)
ctry <- country_row(con, ISO3); CCY <- ctry$ccy
regs <- setdiff(jsonlite::fromJSON(setting(con, B$build_id, "defaults.regressors", numeric = FALSE)), CCY)
st   <- status_all(con, B$build_id); st <- st[st$iso3 == ISO3, ]
reg  <- regimes_ccy(con, B$build_id, CCY)
bd   <- breaks_ccy(con, B$build_id, CCY)
rng  <- returns_range(con, CCY)
lvl  <- level_ccy(con, CCY, rng$start)
onl  <- online_ccy(con, CCY, bc$engine_version)
al   <- alerts_ccy(con, CCY)
rv   <- revisions_ccy(con, CCY)
numeraire <- setting(con, B$build_id, "defaults.numeraire", numeric = FALSE)
# the two downloadable tables are written next to the page from the database at render time
write.csv(regimes_display(reg, regs), paste0(ISO3, "_regimes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
if (nrow(onl)) write.csv(onl[, setdiff(names(onl), "first_seen_build")], paste0(ISO3, "_online.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r status}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
cat(status_text(st, al, bc))
```

The basket weights of the `r CCY` are estimated on weekly returns measured against the `r numeraire`, with the US dollar, the yen, the euro and sterling as the basket. Two procedures run on the same data: a retrospective dating that places the breaks between regimes with the whole sample in hand, and an online filter that, each week, gives the probability that a new regime has begun and watches the residual variance for a change in the width of the band. The [methodology](../../methods.qmd) page sets out both. Sample: `r format(rng$start)` to `r format(rng$end)`.

## `r CCY`/USD level

```{r levels}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| column: page-right
plot_level(lvl, bd, paste0(CCY, "/USD rate"), LOGO)
```

The dashed lines are the dated breaks between regimes.

## Basket weights over time

The step function is the weight estimated for each dated regime. The smooth line is the online filter's posterior mean each week, which uses only the data up to that week.

```{r weights}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| column: page-right
plot_weights_online(reg, onl, regs, LOGO)
```

## Alert history

Alerts of both rules: the probability rule, which reports the most probable start of the new regime, and the variance rule, which reports the direction of the change and the window within which it is claimed to lie.

```{r alerts}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
alerts_table(al, with_country = FALSE)
```

## Revision history

Each build re-dates the regimes with the data then available. Changes in the dated breaks, and in this country's status, between builds are listed here. The online probabilities above are never revised.

```{r revisions}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
revisions_table(rv, with_country = FALSE)
```
